The compilation was rejected as expected, because your request contains an unsupported override that cannot be reconciled with the registered method.

## Compilation result: REJECTED

**Rejection reason (UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST):**
> PicoGreen reaction volume changed to 500 µL per well (registered method is 200 µL total: 100 µL prediluted sample + 100 µL working reagent)

The Quant-iT PicoGreen high-range method is registered (`quantit.picogreen.highrange/v2`) with a fixed 200 µL microplate format — 100 µL prediluted sample + 100 µL working reagent. Registered methods cannot be changed, and an explicit request to alter a registered volume is a hard rejection case even though you asked to keep the method name. This is not a missing-field clarification; it is an unsupported override, so no schedule was produced.

## What was otherwise valid and correctly captured

| Experiment | Method | Samples | Replicates | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GFP | `gfp` | 1 | 1 | Positive template + its NTC (gfp samples=1 implies both), single reaction each |
| BCA | `bca` | 2 | 2 | 2 unknowns + 9 registered standards, all in duplicate |
| PicoGreen | `picogreen` | 3 | 1 | 3 unknowns + 4 registered standards, single well each |

- **Time window:** 09:00 Shanghai (t=0) → 15:00 deadline = 21,600 s ✓
- **Budget:** CNY 570 ✓
- **Enabled devices:** device:19, device:18, device:67, demo:ks4000:1, bench ✓
- **Demo assumptions accepted:** estimated costs, handling durations, digital carriers, layout ✓
- **Personnel/transport:** cellfreeMIX, standards, working reagents human-prepared; manual transport allowed; liquid-handling assembly remains automated ✓
- **Controls:** all registered assay conditions and controls retained ✓

## To proceed

Remove or revise the PicoGreen 500 µL per-well request to the registered 200 µL format (100 µL prediluted sample + 100 µL working reagent), and I can recompile the portfolio immediately. Everything else in your request is valid and ready to schedule.
